title: Support user-defined node kinds with an open node map
context: Alternative approaches: closed set of node kinds; only allow built-in kinds; require pre-definition of all types.
decision: A user can register a new node kind via surface S-25, declare the edge kinds the schema accepts, and the new kind joins the graph. The system uses an open map for user-defined kinds, not a tagged enum.
consequences: Extensibility without code changes; users can model domain-specific concepts; new kinds must follow the same rules (linting, reconciliation) as built-in kinds; schema validation must use allowlisting for edges.
